what_changed: PO-7781's 400 MC-500 controllers, all due on day 5, now arrive as 120 on day 5 and the remaining 280 on day 26.
decisions_for_a_person: Whether to accept Northgate's offer to discuss other options this week, for example getting at least 90 more controllers before day 14 so O-1043 (late penalty) and the other orders at risk ship on time. No option like this has been tested.
How to handle O-1043 for City of Ashford Bike Share: 10 bikes would be 12 days late on an order with a late penalty.
What, if anything, to tell Northgate about which customers are affected, since sharing customer names and order details with a supplier is a business decision.
supplier_questions: Which of Brookfield's customers are most affected, so Northgate can understand the impact on Brookfield's side?
